Subject: Renewal workshop slots - priority sweep & standby plan

Hi Claire / Rajiv,

Happy Friday — excited to get the renewal workshop on the calendar. Our goal for the session is to: walk through the roadmap items tied to your expansion priorities, review performance/latency improvements from the last quarter, and land on a mutually agreed rollout sequence for the dedicated capacity commit.

To make scheduling fast, here are three prioritized 90‑minute windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue, Nov 10 — 10:00–11:30 PT (exec + architects)
- Option B: Wed, Nov 11 — 13:00–14:30 PT (full product/CS workshop)
- Option C: Thu, Nov 12 — 08:00–09:30 PT (early region overlap; lighter attendance)

If none of those work, send your top two 2‑hour windows and we will propose a standby slot (we can stand up a technical deep‑dive within 24 hours if needed). Attached is a draft agenda and a small capacity worksheet so you can confirm expected Q4 throughput.

Quick asks from our side:
- Please confirm the core attendees (exec, infra lead, product owner) — I added medcore_exec_roster.csv to attachments if helpful.
- Flag any hard no dates for the week of Nov 8–14 so we avoid churn.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

- Exec (our CTO) has a standing board prep on Nov 10 at 10:00 PT, so Option A is a hard no.
- Rajiv and I prefer a morning slot; Nov 11 at 13:00 PT (Option B) conflicts with our internal compliance review.

Proposed alternatives (all PT):
- Alt 1: Mon, Nov 9 — 09:30–11:00 (we can shift internal reviews)
- Alt 2: Fri, Nov 13 — 11:00–12:30 (exec can join 30 mins at the start)

Also: our exec asked for an option where they can join the first 30 minutes for high‑level alignment and then hand off to Rajiv and product — is that something Redwood can support? If you can hold a standby window on Nov 12 morning for a technical deep‑dive that would be helpful as well.

Thanks Claire — good context. Two operational proposals to minimize churn and ensure exec coverage:

1) Priority sweep approach:
- Lock the workshop for Fri, Nov 13 — 11:00–12:30 PT (exec joins 11:00–11:30).
- During week of Nov 9 we will run a 45‑minute pre‑kick for the infra/product leads (Nov 9 morning) to surface any blockers so the full workshop is high value.

2) Standby contingency (technical deep‑dive):
- Standby window Thu, Nov 12 — 08:00–10:00 PT reserved for anything that needs a fast follow‑up (we'll hold an internal host and an engineer on call). If an immediate deep‑dive is needed after the pre‑kick, we flip the standby into a dedicated session.

Operational notes:
- We'll send two calendar items: (a) the 90‑minute workshop with exec partial attendance, and (b) a short 45‑minute pre‑kick. Both will be set as tentative until you confirm.
- If you prefer Mon Nov 9 as the main slot instead, we can flip — we just want to ensure the pre‑kick still happens at least 48 hours beforehand.

I'll attach a short run‑of‑show and the names of the Redwood engineers who will be on the standby list.

Thanks — Marissa
